verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists native HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, which is a first-party CRM capability. Nothing in the evidence describes what those integrations do, so automatic logging of calls and texts and matching them to the right contact are only implied. missing for 10: documentation that calls and texts log to the CRM automatically, contact-matching behavior, which activity types sync (calls, texts, recordings, transcripts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
